claim_scope: exact selected 120 future-null-infinity scattered mode/channel/incident-column records

waveform_amplitude_definition.observable: scattered outgoing Martel-Poisson master coefficient at future null infinity

sector_bridge.odd: F_odd=2 i/omega for Psi_CPM=(2 i/omega) Psi_RW

waveform_amplitude_definition.qualification: C_record is fixed by the V2.0 incident normalization and is never fitted to a route result

preexecution_source_diagnostics.method: recomputed from the already immutable 30 V1 selected comparison records before any V2.2 route execution

scale_normalized_complex_difference.mandatory_when: every record for the applicable route pair

phase_invariant_scale_normalized_magnitu.mandatory_when: every record for the applicable route pair
phase_invariant_scale_normalized_magnitu.invariance: unchanged by an arbitrary unit-modulus phase applied independently to either scalar amplitude

common_applicability.signal_floor_failure_policy: FAIL_CURRENT_GATE; do not silently mark the mandatory selected record unassessed
common_applicability.reason: the floor is a generic ten-percent incident-scale conditioning bound and is below both preexecution source minima by more than a factor of two

A_B.threshold_source: preexecution analytic-route roundoff envelope; not fitted to a V2.2 result
A_B.derivation: epsilon_AB=1e-12; D_relmag<=epsilon_AB/0.1; D_phase<=2 asin(epsilon_AB/(2*0.1)); the stored phase bound rounds that geometric bound upward

A_C.threshold_source: explicit propagation of V1 selected backend_complex_S threshold 2e-6 through H_sc=F*c*(-1)^ell*(1-S); not a silent radial-threshold relabel
A_C.derivation: epsilon_external=2e-6; D_complex=abs(S_A-S_C); D_relmag<=epsilon_external/0.1; D_phase<=2 asin(epsilon_external/(2*0.1)); the stored phase bound rounds that geometric bound upward

B_C.threshold_source: triangle allocation epsilon_external=2e-6 with the A_B route-map error required to remain <=1e-12; not fitted to a V2.2 result
B_C.derivation: epsilon_BC=epsilon_external+epsilon_AB=2.001e-6; magnitude and phase bounds use the same 0.1 signal floor and are rounded upward

acceptance_logic.record_inventory_policy: all 120 records and all three route pairs must be present; no subset acceptance or dropped near-zero channel
acceptance_logic.mandatory_comparator_policy: every applicable comparator must be finite and <= its exact route-pair threshold
acceptance_logic.absolute_phase_nonclaim: the selected relative phases are tested without fitting, but the common absolute phase convention is not independently convention-free and is not promoted beyond PARTIAL in V2.2
acceptance_logic.advance_semantics: CLAIM_STATUS=PARTIAL may accompany ADVANCE when all frozen magnitude, relative-phase, phase-invariant and inventory criteria pass
acceptance_logic.claim_adjudication: per observable and exact selected 120-record domain only

separate_uncertainty_budget_policy.unassessed_policy: missing components remain NOT_ASSESSED or PARTIAL and are never encoded as zero

forbidden_operations_and_claims: modify any frozen V2.0 convention or selected-domain byte
modify or call any radial backend
fit a per-mode or global complex phase or scale
sum a total plane wave at null infinity
use Li figure agreement as an acceptance gate
claim full-domain V2 or global GREEN
